title: Glorious Things of You Are Spoken

questions.question: On the holy mount stands the city he what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 87:1 (ESV): "On the holy mount stands the city he founded;"

questions.question: The Lord loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwelling places of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 87:2 (ESV): "The Lord loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwelling places of Jacob."

questions.question: Glorious things of you are spoken, O city of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 87:3 (ESV): "Glorious things of you are spoken, O city of God."

questions.question: Among those who know me I mention Rahab and whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 87:4 (ESV): "Among those who know me I mention Rahab and Babylon;"

questions.question: Behold, Philistia and Tyre, with Cush—"This one was born where?"
And of Zion it shall be said, "This one and that one were born in her"; for the Most High himself will do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 87:5 (ESV): "for the Most High himself will establish her."

questions.question: The Lord records as he registers the peoples, "This one was born where?"
Singers and dancers alike say, "All my springs are in whom?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 87:7 (ESV): "Singers and dancers alike say, 'All my springs are in you.'"

questions.question: What is another name for Egypt used in this Psalm?
questions.explanation: Psalm 87:4 (ESV). Rahab is a poetic name for Egypt.

questions.question: Who loves the gates of Zion?
questions.explanation: Psalm 87:2 (ESV): "The Lord loves the gates of Zion..."

questions.question: What stands on the holy mount?
questions.explanation: Psalm 87:1 (ESV): "On the holy mount stands the city he founded;"

questions.question: How many times does the word "Selah" appear in Psalm 87?
questions.explanation: At the end of verse 3 and verse 6 in the ESV.

questions.question: This Psalm is attributed to whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 87 Title: "A Psalm of the Sons of Korah. A Song."

questions.question: Who records the peoples?
questions.explanation: Psalm 87:6 (ESV): "The Lord records as he registers the peoples,"

questions.question: All my springs are in whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 87:7 (ESV): "All my springs are in you."

key_verse_text: Glorious things of you are spoken, O city of God.
